decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost logistics offer that strengthens the established door business and remained on the website in both years, so it is likely to stay.

The seventy-two-hour express delivery is a differentiating service that fits the firm's fast-response promise, but it is costly to run and is only mentioned on the website, so it carries slightly more risk.
The express program for doors and gates has had its own page in both years and supports trade partners, so it is a stable part of the offer.
The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic investment in digitalization and service depth that firms rarely abandon once established.
The fire and smoke protection door moved up to its own page in 2024 and appears to have replaced the withdrawn fire-resistant door, which shows growing commitment.
